core_meaning.primary_meaning: Riza is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Satisfaction, contentment”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Riza corresponds to the Arabic form رِضَا (Arabic root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w); رِضَا (Riḍā)). Its core sense is riza; satisfaction, contentment. Riza is a spelling variant of Arabic رِضَا (Riḍā) 'satisfaction, contentment', from the root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave رزا (a non-standard form). The source gloss 'Contentment, Pleasure, Gladness' is broadly consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly male. Same name as raza.

persian.name: رضا
persian.long_meaning: Riza (رضا) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رضا، خشنودی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
